audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition: hasSeenDataColumnIndex (L157) check and setSeenDataColumnIndex (subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go:42) are not atomic. Two identical data column sidecars received concurrently can both pass the duplicate check and proceed through all REJECT validations before either updates the cache. The RWMutex in slotAwareCache only protects individual Get/Add operations, not the check-then-act sequence across validation→subscription flow.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts identical data column sidecar to multiple peers simultaneously. Both messages pass duplicate check (L157) concurrently, both execute expensive REJECT validations (KZG proofs, signature verification, inclusion proofs), and both are forwarded to the gossip network, causing amplified bandwidth/CPU consumption across the network.
